name: GrønlandsBANKEN A/S
summary: GrønlandsBANKEN A/S provides various financial services to private and business customers, and public institutions in Greenland. It offers housing services, including buying a home, loan restructuring, purchase of cooperative apartment, renovation, property sale, construction or renovation, and equity services; car, snowmobile, climate and environmental, personal, boat, and quick loans; savings, budgeting, insurance, cards, security, and associations; Qimatut and lifetime pension, critical illness, and health and life insurance; and investment services. The company also provides business consulting for property, construction and civil engineering, fishing, tourism, trade, liberal professions…
